title: Third Shot Drop
style: Comedy phonk-jazz with swung boom-bap drums, wobbling sub-bass, brushed kit accents, and cheeky upright bass riffs; verse rides sparse with tongue-twister couplets and playful call-and-response, pre-chorus strips to hi-hat ticks and vocal chops, chorus lands with stomped gang shouts and sax stabs. [M] and [F] duet vocals with doubled punchlines, quick ad-libs, delay throws on rhyme words, tiny vinyl crackle, reverse cymbal lifts, bright punchy mix with a dusty club feel., comedy, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[M] Pickle bee dee bee ball
[F] Bee bop de da da
[M] Shoes tap on the line
[F] Paddle in your paw
[M] Third shot drop shot
[F] Soft like a feather
[M] You reach, I tease
[F] We dance together

[Pre-Chorus]
[M] One bounce, two bounce
[F] Eyes on the kitchen
[M] You swing too hard
[F] I grin in the middle
[M] Here comes the drop
[F] Right over the net
[M] Small little trick
[F] Big little threat

[Chorus]
[M] Pickle a pickle ball pro
[F] Pro, pro, pro
[M] Pickle a pickle ball pro
[F] Watch me go
[M] Pickle ball smash
[F] Then I’m gone
[M] Safe and sound
[F] I’m still on

[Verse 2]
[M] You lunge for the corner
[F] I send it slow
[M] You bark, “too cute”
[F] I say, “I know”
[M] Barely clears the tape
[F] Lands like a sigh
[M] Your grin gets crooked
[F] Mine stays high

[Pre-Chorus]
[M] One bounce, two bounce
[F] Eyes on the kitchen
[M] You swing too hard
[F] I grin in the middle
[M] Here comes the drop
[F] Right over the net
[M] Small little trick
[F] Big little threat

[Chorus]
[M] Pickle a pickle ball pro
[F] Pro, pro, pro
[M] Pickle a pickle ball pro
[F] Watch me go
[M] Pickle ball smash
[F] Then I’m gone
[M] Safe and sound
[F] I’m still on

[Bridge]
[F] You call it chaos
[M] I call it art
[F] You bring the thunder
[M] I bring the smart
[F] Toe on the line
[M] Hand on the paddle
[F] We laugh at the net
[M] Then rattle and rattle

[Final Chorus]
[M] Pickle a pickle ball pro
[F] Pro, pro, pro
[M] Pickle a pickle ball pro
[F] Watch me go
[M] Pickle ball smash
[F] Then I’m gone
[M] Safe and sound
[F] I’m still on
